Who We Are 
 At Justworks, you’ll enjoy a welcoming and casual environment, great benefits, wellness program offerings, company retreats, and the ability to interact with and learn from leaders in the startup community. We work hard and care about our most prized asset - our people. 
 We’re helping businesses get off the ground by enabling them to focus on running their business. We solve HR issues. We’re data-driven and never stop iterating. If you’d like to work in a supportive, entrepreneurial environment, are interested in building something meaningful and having fun while doing it, we’d love to hear from you. 
 We're united by shared goals and shared motivations at Justworks. These are best summed up in our company values, which are reflected in our product and in our team. 
 Our Values 
 If this sounds like you, you’ll fit right in. 
 Department 
 Technology, Data & Analytics Team
 Who You Are 
 You're an experienced data scientist who gets excited about understanding how customers interact with a product – and using that understanding to help teams make smarter decisions. You're a trusted data storyteller: you can write a tight SQL query, design a rigorous experiment, and then turn those findings into a narrative that moves a roadmap. You believe that the best data science work accelerates learning, improves decision making, and ultimately drives measurable impact for customers and the business.
 Justworks is looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our Product Analytics group within the Data & Analytics team. You'll partner across Product, Engineering, Design, Finance, Marketing, and Revenue to define success metrics, run experiments, size opportunities, and build a data-informed approach to how we grow and improve our product.

 Lead end-to-end analytics projects, from defining metrics to analyzing data and delivering insights
 Partner with product leaders to define and measure goal metrics
 Design and analyze A/B tests, quasi-experiments, and causal analyses to measure the impact of product changes and help teams understand not just if something worked, but why 
 Accelerate product learning cycles through frameworks for experimentation, measurement, and iteration so teams can move faster without sacrificing rigor
 Analyze strategic opportunities to inform roadmap prioritization
 Build compelling narratives from complex data, presenting findings in ways that influence decisions with both technical and non-technical audiences, from product pods to senior leadership
 Identify friction and opportunity across the customer lifecycle, from onboarding flows to feature adoption to retention signals, and translate what you find into actionable strategies
 Develop and apply AI-assisted approaches to analysis, insight delivery, and data workflows to multiply your impact and expand the reach of data science across the organization
 Partner with data engineering and analytics engineering to improve data foundations, instrument key events, and ensure the right data exists to answer the questions product teams are asking
 Perform other related responsibilities as needed based on department and/or organizational needs.

 Judi Health is a health technology company providing benefit administration solutions to employers, unions, health plans, and government entities. By delivering true price transparency, eliminating unnecessary middleman fees, and leveraging advanced AI-powered care delivery, Judi Health helps clients achieve unprecedented operational efficiency and service levels. At Judi Health, we're deploying the infrastructure our country needs to deliver the healthcare we all deserve. title: Data Scientist
description:
About Fora 
 Fora is the modern travel agency, empowering the next generation of entrepreneurs to build thriving travel advisory businesses. We're modernizing the $100B+ travel industry with AI woven through every part of the advisor's workflow, plus global supplier relationships, personalized training, and a vibrant community, all in one place. That's what lets advisors build businesses that scale, while their taste and service create trips no algorithm alone could plan. At the heart of it all is our mission: to help the next generation of travel entrepreneurs turn their love for travel into a fulfilling career, whether full-time or part-time. 
 We're mission-driven and obsessed with our customers, and we believe humans and AI are both essential: the best work here comes from people and technology at their best, together. That's not just a philosophy about our product, it's how we build our team. Everyone at Fora gets hands-on with frontier AI tooling as part of the job. At Fora, you'll learn to be AI-fluent, with real experience applying AI to solve problems day to day, wherever you sit in the company. 
 Founded in 2021, Fora has grown to a team of 250+ full-time employees based in downtown New York City . In 2026, we closed a $60 million Series D led by Forerunner and Tactile Ventures, with continued backing from Thrive Capital, Insight Partners, and Heartcore Capital. We've been named a LinkedIn Top Startup (2024), one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies (2023 and 2025), and one of TIME's 100 Most Influential Companies (2026).
 Come build something that hasn't existed before.
 About The Org 
 Data Science is a central org that sits at the center of how Fora makes decisions, from product and marketing to the plans leadership sets for the company. We own the metrics Fora runs on, the experiments that show what works, and the analyses that set the roadmap.
 About The Role 
 You'll be the analytical partner for one area of the business and own its hardest questions: is this working, why, and what should we do next. Most of them are causal. You'll also build data products, reusable tools and AI workflows, that the rest of Fora uses every day.
 What you'll do 
 Measure what changes cause : experiments, holdouts, quasi-experimental methods.
 Define success : north-star, leading and guardrail metrics, from logging to definition.
 Turn findings into decisions , and follow through on whether they worked.
 Focus Areas 
 Product. Partner with product and engineering on what moves bookings, not usage.
 Growth. Acquisition to retention: incrementality, churn, early signals of success.
 Experimentation & Statistics. Experiment design and quasi-experimental methods.
 Agent Evals. Prove our AI agents work: eval sets, LLM judges, links to bookings.
 Focus Areas 
 Have taken ambiguous questions to decisions and measurable results.
 Write production SQL and Python, and check your own numbers (R considered).
 Explain technical work plainly to executives and change minds with evidence.
 Have run experiments end to end, and used causal inference when you couldn't.
 Use AI tools to work faster and know how to check what they produce.
 Compensation
 Compensation for this role varies based on experience, with an indicative range of $158K–$239K + equity. Final compensation will depend on the level at which the candidate is hired, as we’re considering multiple levels for this role.
